race.comment: ANGELIC ATTITUDE (4) has been excellent of late and made it two wins in a row at this venue when successful at her latest appearance over this distance, getting home by 1.5 metres. Draws wider and steps up a level but she could be up to the task. KUALIGHT (8) resumes after great success last prep, winning on three occasions. May need a bit of luck negotiating a very wide starting position but she is proven fresh and was readied with a recent trial. ALABAMA LIONESS (7) is on the radar after her last-start fourth from a similar barrier at Menangle and had recorded back-to-back seconds prior, missing by a nose at Bathurst two back. BETTES BLUE VIOLET (3) comes back in grade on recent attempts so can be competitive.
